_comment: Queue-size hypothesis test: rocketfuel_1755 onephase at bw=10 Mbps, pipeline=20 (baseline), queue_size=10 (10x smaller than default). If queue overflow matters, a smaller queue should make things worse. Run with: sudo ./jobs.sh start --fresh prefix_scale/rocketfuel_1755_onephase_queue10_3stage
name: rocketfuel_1755_onephase_p0to2000by2000_bw10Mbps_q10
description: rocketfuel_1755 onephase at bw=10 Mbps with queue_size=10 (vs baseline 100). Tests whether per-link queue overflow causes the DV heartbeat drops.

jobs.name: stage1: DV convergence snapshot (onephase, 0 prefixes, bw=10, queue=10)
stage2: onephase prefix table measurement p0 (import DV snap, bw=10, queue=10)
stage2: onephase prefix table measurement p2000 (import DV snap, bw=10, queue=10)
